description: Wiki.js: a wiki with Markdown and visual editors, Git sync and many auth providers, on the bundled PostgreSQL, with the first administrator from a generated Secret. Hardened by QuenchWorks: built from source, CVE-gated, cosign-signed and pinned by digest.

Calibre-Web: browse, read and download an ebook library kept in a Calibre database, with the admin password from a generated Secret (never admin123). Hardened by QuenchWorks: built from source, CVE-gated, cosign-signed and pinned by digest.
